Free shipping in Canada and continental United States on orders over $99 USD 2 year standard warranty doubled to 4 years when you register your pedal! All returns accepted within 45 days of purchase User Manual English Support Most overdrives are built around one particular character. The Empress Drive gives you the tools to shape your own. Instead of locking you into a single flavour of overdrive, it lets you shape the harmonic structure that determines how a drive sounds and responds. With pre-overdrive mid shaping, flexible boost routing, clean blend, and post-mix EQ, the Empress Drive can move from subtle edge-of-breakup push to saturated, harmonically rich drive, either enhancing the character of your guitar and amp or taking your sound somewhere entirely new. Add to Cart Testimonials [The Empress Drive] is like super super amp-like, and I don't mean that in a like "everybody says it". It feels like you're playing a cranked amp. Sounds awesome. — Josh Scott, JHS Pedals The Empress Drive is seriously one of the most versatile overdrives I have tried to date. You can transform your clean amp into a very angry tweed Deluxe, or use it as a flamethrower with all the gain it has on tap. PLUS even if it did absolutely nothing the aesthetic is totally worth the price of admission. — Ben Flanders (MD/Guitarist for Ella Langley) I really appreciate the EQ. Most drives have a tone dial, but the degree to which you can EQ your sound with this pedal is special. The BASS, MIDRANGE, TREBLE, MID FREQ, MIX, and GAIN dials invite sonic exploration. A wide variety of sonic possibilities can be created. This pedal allows guitarists to sculpt a custom sound. It's fantastic! — Donna Grantis (Prince, 3RDEYEGIRL) It sounds sooo good!!! The main drive sounds natural and just perfect to my ears :) Then being able to customize is awesome, with the Mid Freq sweep that’s pleasing across the spectrum. The gate works smoothly too, there are no weird cut-outs or change in tone. The dry signal mix is so useful for many situations, and I love that it sounds clear and natural. — Barbie Almalbis Honasan Empress' new Drive box makes my BassBot 303 clone sound like Jimmy Page! like when his bowing technique makes your skin shiver, just enough grit, just enough overtone, just enough boost. — Andrew Whiteman (Broken Social Scene) Features Tube-like overdrive with advanced tone control Sweepable Midrange for precise harmonic shaping Mix control to preserve your amp’s natural breakup Active Bass and Treble shelving filters Up to 30 dB of pre- or post-clipping, footswitchable boost Built-in analog clipping meter with selectable LED colour Adaptive noise gate Breakup Control Most overdrives shape tone after distortion. The Empress Drive shapes it before. With the Midrange control placed ahead of the overdrive stage, adjusting it changes which frequencies push the circuit into saturation.
